expected: Explicit ensureTask permits empty list/next/stop/resume; reads do not create missing tasks.
observed: Explicit task creation permits empty state and controls; reads never create unknown tasks.

expected: The same task/message ID and text produces one queued message.
observed: Retrying the same request ID preserves one instruction.

expected: The same message ID with different text conflicts without rewriting original intent.
observed: A reused ID with different content cannot rewrite intent.

expected: Only one instruction may be sending; completion permits the next queued ID.
observed: Only completion of the active instruction permits the next dispatch.

expected: Enqueueing a follow-up preserves current sending state and does not pause.
observed: A normal follow-up message leaves the active execution intact.

expected: Stop preserves active and pending messages; confirmed completion still needs explicit resume.
observed: Stop pauses dispatch and preserves pending intent; it does not claim the remote process stopped.

expected: Uncertain delivery blocks all later dispatch and cannot be bypassed by resume.
observed: Ambiguous delivery blocks both automatic retries and later instructions.

expected: Reopening a sending queue persists uncertain status before allowing any dispatch.
observed: Recovery converts sending to uncertain before any new dispatch.

expected: A new Node process dispatches only the pending message and preserves both completion records.
observed: A new Node process resumes only pending work and never re-dispatches completed work.

expected: Uncertain resolution requires evidence and explicit resume before the next message.
observed: Recorded completion evidence and explicit resume are both needed after uncertainty.

expected: An acknowledgement for another task does not complete the active instruction.
observed: Acknowledgement cannot cross task ownership boundaries.

expected: Invalid IDs, empty text and messages over20000 characters are rejected.
observed: Path-like IDs, empty and oversized messages are rejected.

expected: Mutating list output cannot change durable text or instruction status.
observed: Returned message data cannot bypass durable transitions.
